summary: Thursday’s report lists five Ohio State starters as questionable for Maryland. Confirm the active receiver and defensive rotations, watch protection at right tackle and look for cleaner special teams at Homecoming.

lead.headline: Check who is taking the snaps.
lead.body: Follow the active receiver group and protection at right tackle. On defense, keep Maryland’s short completions from turning into long gains; on special teams, protect the field position.
